name: read_file
description: Reads the contents of a file from the local filesystem.

path.description: relative path to file to read

name: write_file
description: Writes content to a specified file path, creating it if it doesn't exist.

name: edit_file
description: Begin a file-editing session, entering a new interactive mode for accurate file viewing and editing. Shows a moveable glimpse/squint view of a file. **The Preferred file-editing and file-viewing tool.**

intent.description: detailed, clear plan for this file-editing session to be parsed by the Editor Agent that will persist during the editing session.

name: run_bash
description: Executes a complete shell code, with pipes, quotations, and parenthesis and other bash. This 'code' argument is written to a temp file and executed with bash <tmpfile> and the output (stdout/stderr combined) is returned.

name: list_directory
description: Lists files and directories in a given path.

path.description: relative path to dir, or single dot

name: get_package_info
description: Retrieves information about a specific Go module or package version.
